mapper.insert: insert into pw_card_ai_cache ( owner_user_id, content_fingerprint, prompt_fingerprint, prompt, content, think_used, last_accessed_at, last_generated_at ) values ( #{ownerUserId}, #{fingerprint}, #{promptFingerprint}, #{prompt}, #{content}, #{thinkUsed}, #{accessedAt}, #{generatedAt} ) on conflict (owner_user_id, content_fingerprint) do update set prompt_fingerprint = excluded.prompt_fingerprint, prompt = excluded.prompt, content = excluded.content, think_used = excluded.think_used, last_accessed_at = coalesce(excluded.last_accessed_at, pw_card_ai_cache.last_accessed_at), last_generated_at = excluded.last_generated_at
mapper.delete: with rows_to_delete as ( select id from pw_card_ai_cache where ( (last_accessed_at is not null and last_accessed_at < #{before}) or (last_accessed_at is null and last_generated_at is not null and last_generated_at < #{before}) ) and prompt not in ( select content from ( select trim(c.side_a) as content from pw_card c where c.side_a is not null and trim(c.side_a) != '' and not exists ( select 1 from pw_card_progress cp where cp.card_id = c.id and cp.state != 'new' ) union select trim(c.side_b) as content from pw_card c where c.side_b is not null and trim(c.side_b) != '' and not exists ( select 1 from pw_card_progress cp where cp.card_id = c.id and cp.state != 'new' ) ) t ) order by coalesce(last_accessed_at, last_generated_at) asc limit #{limit} ) delete from pw_card_ai_cache using rows_to_delete where pw_card_ai_cache.id = rows_to_delete.id
